title: Backlog when arrivals exceed completions
method: Synthetic constant-rate model: arrivals 120/s, completions 100/s, initially empty queue. Backlog = (120 − 100) × seconds. Excludes retries, in-flight jobs and changing service cost; not a latency benchmark.
alt: Backlog when arrivals exceed completions. After 10 seconds: 200 waiting jobs; After 20 seconds: 400 waiting jobs; After 30 seconds: 600 waiting jobs. Illustrative inputs.
